entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with short, light-colored hair, wearing a dark, nearly black coat, mostly facing away from the camera and positioned below Person B.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: A rough grayish-brown masonry wall behind the wooden structure, locally lighter beside the window.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: An interlaced wooden structure composed of thick wooden posts, crossbeams, diagonal braces, stair treads, and integrated railings.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person on a higher section of the stairs, wearing a dark long-sleeved top, a gray knee-length skirt, and dark shoes.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: A bright opening in the wall on the right, with thick, light-colored sidewalls and partially occluded by the wooden structure.

entities.name: Blue-and-white bright area outside the window
entities.identification: A narrow strip of blue-and-white highlighted area visible through the Window opening in the wall.
